title: Puebla Cathedral

buildingCutout.basis: The surveyed geographic footprint follows the full mapped cathedral perimeter.

identities.name: Puebla Cathedral
identities.address: Avenida 16 de Septiembre, Centro Histórico, Puebla de Zaragoza, México

mapIdentity.scope: The named historic cathedral footprint, two mapped belfry corners and crossing dome define position and orientation. The standing roof arrangment was interpreted from the cleared aerial footage and nadir still.

note: The Qualla drone views establish open stacked arched belfries, the triple dark stone facade, gray-brown vaulted roof, brick-red crossing drum, and gold and green glazed dome. Heritage documentation gives the approximate tower height.
